rules.smart_double: Curly double quotes (“”) — flag straight doubles (") and any single-quoted dialogue
rules.dumb_double: Straight double quotes (") — flag curly doubles (“”) and any single-quoted dialogue
rules.smart_single: Curly single quotes (‘’) — flag straight singles (') and any double-quoted dialogue
rules.dumb_single: Straight single quotes (') — flag curly singles (‘’) and any double-quoted dialogue

rules.nbsp_spaced: Dots separated by non-breaking spaces (. . .) — flag plain dots (...), spaced dots (. . .), and Unicode (…)
rules.spaced: Dots separated by regular spaces (. . .) — flag non-breaking-space dots, plain dots (...), and Unicode (…)
rules.unicode: Unicode ellipsis character (…) — flag plain dots (...) and spaced dots (. . .)
rules.unspaced: Three plain dots (...) — flag Unicode (…) and spaced dots (. . .)

rules.tight: No spaces around em dash (word—word) — flag spaced em dashes (word — word)
rules.spaced: Spaces around em dash (word — word) — flag tight em dashes (word—word)

rules.yes: Oxford comma before ‘and’ in lists (a, b, and c) — flag missing serial commas
rules.no: No Oxford comma (a, b and c) — flag spurious serial commas

rules.american: American English — flag British spellings: -ise/-isation endings (realise → realize, recognised → recognized, organised → organized), -our endings (colour → color, favour → favor), -re endings (centre → center, theatre → theater), doubled consonants in inflections (travelling → traveling, cancelled → canceled)
rules.british: British English — flag American spellings: -ize/-ization endings (realize → realise, recognized → recognised), -or endings (color → colour, favor → favour), -er endings (center → centre, theater → theatre)
